Let me go through each example systematically:

**Example 1 (2024-07-19)** - This is the most recent and has the most errors

Looking at the pattern:
- Model forecasts are generally lower than true outcomes
- The divergence seems to increase with time (lag effect?)
- Sentiment history shows positivity initially (1.00, 0.67, etc.) but the model under-predicted the continued upward momentum

Let me look at specific differences:

- Day 5: Model 67.72 vs True 67.08 (underpredicted by +0.64)
- Day 10: Model 69.90 vs True 71.17 (underpredicted by +1.27)
- Day 15: Model 68.29 vs True 70.14 (underpredicted by +1.85)
- Day 20: Model 70.85 vs True 72.52 (underpredicted by +1.67)
- Day 25: Model 69.98 vs True 72.14 (underpredicted by +2.16)
- Day 30: Model 69.30 vs True 71.57 (underpredicted by +2.27)

The error increases over the 30-day horizon! The model is too conservative and misses the upside momentum, especially as we look further into the future.
